answer: In PoA, each identity must lock bonded collateral, making sybil control economically costly. If k coordinated identities equivocate on conflicting statements, correlated penalties scale as O(k²), because pairwise evidence compounds the slash. Detection then applies an exponential capital-loss multiplier to the swarm, rapidly exhausting escrows and discouraging attacks. This voyage from isolated faults to coordinated failure is no sonnet; the tide of penalties rises with every linked identity.
